changes.incident_name_enumeration: bounded at 4096 JSON entries and 5120 total directory entries
changes.incident_read: latest deterministic filename only, bounded to 1048576 bytes, owner-safe no-follow and stability read on POSIX; explicit reparse-safe bounded read on Windows
changes.semantic_validation: strict UTF-8 and JSON, duplicate-key rejection, v1-or-legacy schema handling, required identity/event time, bounded trigger shape
changes.invalid_latest: reported as invalid custody with a reason and no older incident fallback
changes.summary: carries explicit bounded_record_valid, bounded_legacy_record, absent, invalid, unavailable, or unsupported posture; this is local record custody, not issuer authentication

limitations: A bounded incident artifact is not an authenticated producer record and does not establish hostile activity or defensive consequence.
